title: Reflect After Failure: Brain-Inspired Self-Evolving Agents for Embodied Spatial Intelligence

paragraphs.en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have made substantial progress in spatial reasoning, and self-evolving agents further extend these capabilities to embodied environments by learning from interactions. However, current self-evolution remains particularly challenging in embodied spatial tasks, complex and multi-step decisions from partial visual evidence making it difficult to determine why an execution fails. The failure may stem from misperception, insufficient exploration, or incorrect planning, yet execution feedback alone rarely reveals which component is responsible. As a result, simply accumulating interaction experience can reinforce ineffective strategies. To address this, we propose HiMeco, a brain-inspired self-evolving agent for embodied spatial intelligence, inspired by metacognitive monitoring and hippocampal memory consolidation. Through Hippocampal-Metacognitive Reflection, HiMeco diagnoses failures in perception-exploration-planning (PEP), then compares execution attempts to derive reusable strategies and guidance for avoiding recurring errors. It also abstracts interaction programs into parameterized skills, using evidence contracts and execution-based validation to determine their retention and reuse. These strategies and skills guide subsequent interactions, with memory updated only between rounds and model parameters kept frozen. HiMeco achieves state-of-the-art performance on ESI-Bench, and it also improves accuracy on EmbSpatial-Bench by 3.94 percentage points without evolution.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）在空间推理方面取得了显著进展，而自我进化的智能体则通过从交互中学习，进一步将这些能力扩展到具身环境中。 然而，当前的自我进化在具身空间任务中仍然极具挑战性：基于部分视觉证据做出复杂且多步骤的决策，使得难以判断执行失败的原因。 失败可能源于感知错误、探索不足或规划不当，但仅凭执行反馈很少能揭示具体是哪个环节出了问题。 因此，单纯积累交互经验可能会强化无效的策略。 为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 HiMeco——一种受大脑启发的具身空间智能自我进化智能体，其设计灵感来自元认知监控和海马体记忆巩固机制。 通过“海马-元认知反思”机制，HiMeco 能够诊断感知-探索-规划（PEP）过程中的失败环节，随后对比不同的执行尝试，从而推导出可复用的策略和避免重复错误的方法。 它还将交互程序抽象为参数化技能，并利用证据契约和执行验证来决定这些技能是否保留及复用。 这些策略和技能会指导后续的交互过程，而记忆仅在回合之间更新，模型参数始终保持冻结状态。 HiMeco 在 ESI-Bench 上达到了当前最优性能，并且无需进化也能将 EmbSpatial-Bench 的准确率提升了 3.94 个百分点。

paragraphs.en: Embodied agents operating in complex physical environments require robust spatial intelligence, the ability to not only perceive visible geometry but also reason about hidden structures and topologies ( Majumdar et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Gong et al., 2026 ; Feng et al., 2026 ) . While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable zero-shot reasoning capabilities, their spatial understanding remains fundamentally constrained by passive observation ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Gong et al., 2026 ; Hong et al., 2026 ) . In real-world scenarios riddled with non-line-of-sight (NLOS) occlusions and unobservable physical dynamics, passive VLMs struggle to perform deep spatial reasoning without actively interacting with the environment to uncover latent topologies ( Feng et al., 2026 ; Majumdar et al., 2024 ; Hong et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在复杂物理环境中运行的具身智能体需要强大的空间智能，即不仅要能够感知可见的几何结构，还要能够推理隐藏的结构和拓扑关系（Majumdar 等人，2024；Yang 等人，2025；Gong 等人，2026；Feng 等人，2026）。 尽管视觉-语言模型（VLM）已展现出卓越的零样本推理能力，但其空间理解能力仍从根本上受到被动观察的局限（Yang 等人，2025；Gong 等人，2026；Hong 等人，2026）。 在充满非视线（NLOS）遮挡和不可观测物理动态的真实世界场景中，被动 VLM 难以进行深度空间推理，除非通过主动与环境互动来揭示潜在的拓扑结构（Feng 等人，2026；Majumdar 等人，2024；Hong 等人，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Existing research on enhancing spatial reasoning in VLMs broadly falls into two paradigms based on physical feedback availability: static perception ( Cheng et al., 2024 ; Song et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) and dynamic interaction ( Ziliotto et al., 2025 ; Hong et al., 2026 ) . The former, whether through offline optimization (e.g., SFT or RL) or static prior injection from expert modules (e.g., 3D/depth estimation and prompt engineering), treats the environment as a passive and fixed observation space. Lacking closed-loop interaction, it relies heavily on explicit in-view visual cues, suffering from cognitive blind spots under NLOS occlusions and hidden topologies ( Feng et al., 2026 ; Hong et al., 2026 ) . In contrast, the dynamic interaction paradigm incorporates physical environment feedback into planning, enabling agents to actively resolve local ambiguities ( Ziliotto et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2025 ) . However, extending self-evolving agent to embodied spatial tasks introduces a critical bottleneck. Prior work on self-evolving agent often focused on tasks where the causes of failure are relatively easy to identify. While in embodied spatial tasks, agents must make complex multi-step decisions based on partial and dynamically acquired visual evidence in continuous 3D environments subject to physical noise. These conditions make failures difficult to diagnose, while feedback across interaction rounds offers limited guidance on how to revise the underlying strategies ( Li et al., 2024 ; Duan et al., 2025 ; Qi et al., 2026 ; Ju et al., 2026 ) . This ambiguity hinders agents from reliably assessing which strategies are effective and identifying productive directions for further adaptation. As a result, agents may reinforce flawed experiences and update strategies in the wrong direction, causing errors to accumulate over successive evolution rounds ( Ju et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 现有关于增强 VLMs 空间推理能力的研究，根据物理反馈的可用性大致分为两种范式：静态感知（Cheng 等，2024；Song 等，2025；Zhu 等，2025）和动态交互（Ziliotto 等，2025；Hong 等，2026）。 前者无论是通过离线优化（例如 SFT 或 RL），还是通过从专家模块注入静态先验知识（例如 3D/深度估计和提示工程），都将环境视为一个被动且固定的观察空间。 由于缺乏闭环交互，这种范式严重依赖视野内的明确视觉线索，在 NLOS 遮挡和隐藏拓扑结构下会出现认知盲点（Feng 等，2026；Hong 等，2026）。 相比之下，动态交互范式将物理环境的反馈纳入规划过程，使智能体能够主动解决局部模糊性（Ziliotto 等，2025；Kim 等，2025）。 然而，将自演化智能体扩展到具身空间任务中，会引入一个关键瓶颈。 以往关于自演化智能体的研究通常聚焦于那些失败原因相对容易识别的任务。 而在具身空间任务中，智能体必须在持续变化的 3D 环境中，基于部分且动态获取的视觉证据，做出复杂的多步骤决策，而该环境还受到物理噪声的影响。 这些条件使得故障诊断变得困难，同时各轮交互中的反馈对如何修正底层策略仅提供有限指导（Li 等，2024；Duan 等，2025；Qi 等，2026；Ju 等，2026）。 这种模糊性阻碍了智能体可靠地评估哪些策略有效，并识别出进一步适应的有益方向。 因此，智能体可能会强化有缺陷的经验，并以错误的方向更新策略，导致错误在连续演化轮次中不断累积（Ju 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Remarkably, animals can efficiently distill effective strategies from experience to solve embodied spatial tasks in unfamiliar environments. This adaptive ability of biological brains is supported in part by interactions between the hippocampus and prefrontal metacognitive circuits ( Liao and Losonczy, 2024 ; Jensen et al., 2024 ; Fleming, 2026 ) . In contrast, existing embodied spatial intelligence, whether static (e.g., via parameter updates or external tools) or dynamic self-evolving systems, struggle to deliver accurate spatial reasoning during active exploration ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Feng et al., 2026 ; Hong et al., 2026 ) . Because they cannot determine whether failures stem from noisy perception, suboptimal exploration, or improper planning ( Li et al., 2024 ; Ju et al., 2026 ) . This makes it difficult to translate interaction feedback and accumulated experience into consistent behavioral improvements, leaving errors unresolved across successive interactions ( Ju et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Tian et al., 2026 ) . These limitations motivate Hippocampal-Metacognitive Reflection, which couples failure diagnosis with memory consolidation to guide future interactions. Inspired by these neurobiological functions, we hope to achieve a brain-inspired self-evolving agent equipped with multi-turn Hippocampal-Metacognitive reflection for resource-efficient and adaptive embodied spatial intelligence.

paragraphs.en: Translating this brain-inspired concept into practice presents two challenges. The first is adaptive semantic abstraction: deciding what to retain from repeated interactions and how broadly it should apply ( Zhang et al., 2026b ; Shu et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) . Across interaction and evolution rounds, a parameter-frozen agent must turn individual attempts into reusable strategies and executable skills. Overly specific knowledge transfers poorly, while overly general knowledge loses the detail needed for reliable execution ( Wang et al., 2025e ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) . The second is reliable failure attribution ( Li et al., 2024 ; Ju et al., 2026 ) . An incorrect answer alone does not reveal whether the agent misinterpreted its observations, explored insufficiently, or executed a flawed plan. Without this distinction, the agent may retain unreliable procedures or reinforce ineffective strategies.
paragraphs.zh: 将这一受大脑启发的概念付诸实践存在两个挑战。 第一个挑战是自适应语义抽象：即决定从重复交互中保留哪些信息，以及这些信息应如何广泛地应用（Zhang et al., 2026b；Shu et al., 2026；Xu et al., 2026）。 在交互和演化轮次中，参数固定的智能体必须将个体尝试转化为可重复使用的策略和可执行的技能。 过于具体的知识难以有效迁移，而过于宽泛的知识则会丢失可靠执行所需的细节（Wang et al., 2025e；Zhang et al., 2026b）。 第二个挑战是可靠的失败归因（Li et al., 2024；Ju et al., 2026）。 仅凭一个错误答案，无法判断智能体是误解了观察结果、探索不足，还是执行了有缺陷的计划。 若无法做出这种区分，智能体可能会保留不可靠的流程或强化无效的策略。

sents.en: Translating this brain-inspired concept into practice presents two challenges.
sents.zh: 将这一受大脑启发的概念付诸实践存在两个挑战。

sents.en: The first is adaptive semantic abstraction: deciding what to retain from repeated interactions and how broadly it should apply ( Zhang et al., 2026b ; Shu et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 第一个挑战是自适应语义抽象：即决定从重复交互中保留哪些信息，以及这些信息应如何广泛地应用（Zhang et al., 2026b；Shu et al., 2026；Xu et al., 2026）。

sents.en: Across interaction and evolution rounds, a parameter-frozen agent must turn individual attempts into reusable strategies and executable skills.
sents.zh: 在交互和演化轮次中，参数固定的智能体必须将个体尝试转化为可重复使用的策略和可执行的技能。

sents.en: Overly specific knowledge transfers poorly, while overly general knowledge loses the detail needed for reliable execution ( Wang et al., 2025e ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) .
sents.zh: 过于具体的知识难以有效迁移，而过于宽泛的知识则会丢失可靠执行所需的细节（Wang et al., 2025e；Zhang et al., 2026b）。

sents.en: The second is reliable failure attribution ( Li et al., 2024 ; Ju et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 第二个挑战是可靠的失败归因（Li et al., 2024；Ju et al., 2026）。

sents.en: An incorrect answer alone does not reveal whether the agent misinterpreted its observations, explored insufficiently, or executed a flawed plan.
sents.zh: 仅凭一个错误答案，无法判断智能体是误解了观察结果、探索不足，还是执行了有缺陷的计划。

sents.en: Without this distinction, the agent may retain unreliable procedures or reinforce ineffective strategies.
sents.zh: 若无法做出这种区分，智能体可能会保留不可靠的流程或强化无效的策略。

paragraphs.en: To address these challenges, we propose HiMeco , a brain-inspired self-evolving agent for embodied spatial reasoning. It consolidates interaction experience into a strategy bank ℰ \mathcal{E} and a library of parameterized executable skills 𝒦 \mathcal{K} . Evidence contracts and invocation-based validation govern which skills are retained, promoted, or suspended across evolution rounds. A perception-exploration-planning (PEP) diagnostic module 𝒰 \mathcal{U} uses execution traces, task outcomes, and privileged simulator metadata to assess failures across these three dimensions after execution. These diagnostics guide candidate comparison and reflection, yielding reusable strategies and negative constraints for subsequent interactions. Model parameters remain frozen, and both memories are updated only between rounds.
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 HiMeco——一种受大脑启发、具备自我演化能力的智能体，用于具身空间推理。 它将交互经验整合到策略库 ℰ \mathcal{E} 和参数化可执行技能库 𝒦 \mathcal{K} 中。 证据约束和基于调用的验证机制决定了哪些技能在演化轮次中被保留、推广或暂停。 感知-探索-规划（PEP）诊断模块 𝒰 \mathcal{U} 利用执行轨迹、任务结果以及特权模拟器的元数据，在执行后评估这三个维度上的失败情况。 这些诊断结果指导候选项的对比与反思，从而生成可复用的策略和用于后续交互的负面约束。 模型参数保持冻结状态，且两种记忆仅在轮次之间更新。

paragraphs.en: HiMeco alternates between online inference and offline evolution. During inference, the frozen VLM generates programs conditioned on retrieved experiences and skills, while evidence contracts check the observations and intermediate outputs used for reasoning. Memory remains fixed throughout each interaction round. At the round boundary, diagnostic feedback guides comparative reflection and experience consolidation, while execution outcomes support skill abstraction and lifecycle updates. The resulting memories guide subsequent interactions without modifying model parameters. This separation allows the agent to accumulate experience across rounds while evaluating each attempt against a fixed memory snapshot.
paragraphs.zh: HiMeco 在在线推理和离线演化之间交替进行。 在推理阶段，冻结的 VLM 会根据检索到的经验和技能生成程序，同时证据合约会检查推理过程中使用的观察结果和中间输出。 在整个交互回合中，记忆始终保持固定不变。 在回合结束时，诊断反馈会引导对比性反思和经验整合，而执行结果则支持技能抽象和生命周期更新。 由此产生的记忆会指导后续交互，但不会修改模型参数。 这种分离使得智能体能够在各回合中积累经验，同时将每次尝试与固定的记忆快照进行对比评估。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: We propose HiMeco , a brain-inspired self-evolving agent for embodied spatial reasoning, which repeats interaction and memory evolution without updating model parameters.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 HiMeco——一种受大脑启发的自演化智能体，用于具身空间推理。它通过重复交互和记忆演化来完成任务，而无需更新模型参数。

paragraphs.en: We develop a Hippocampal-Metacognitive Reflection mechanism that couples PEP diagnostic module with the consolidation of reusable strategies and parameterized skills.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开发了一种海马-元认知反思机制，该机制将 PEP 诊断模块与可复用策略和参数化技能的巩固相结合。

paragraphs.en: We comprehensively evaluate on ESI-Bench for active embodied spatial reasoning, HiMeco demonstrating state-of-the-art performance. It also improves accuracy on EmbSpatial-Bench without evolution, showing its effectiveness in passive settings.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 ESI-Bench 上对主动具身空间推理进行了全面评估，HiMeco 展现了当前最先进的性能。 它在没有进化的情况下也提升了 EmbSpatial-Bench 的准确率，证明了其在被动场景中的有效性。

paragraphs.en: Benchmarks span static visual reasoning, such as EmbSpatial-Bench ( Du et al., 2024 ) , and interactive evaluation, such as ESI-Bench ( Hong et al., 2026 ) , which requires acquiring evidence through actions. Existing approaches use task-specific fine-tuning ( Song et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) , explicit 3D memory ( Zeng et al., 2026 ; Zheng et al., 2025 ) , or interactive exploration ( Ziliotto et al., 2025 ; Hong et al., 2026 ) to improve spatial understanding. Training-free alternatives organize frozen models within external structure: TANGO composes navigation and perception primitives into task-specific programs without additional training ( Ziliotto et al., 2025 ) , NeSy-Spatial abstracts tool interactions into typed and composable spatial skills that self-evolve with use ( Tian et al., 2026 ) , and Spatial Memory Agent consolidates verified spatial experience into transferable procedural lessons ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) . However, effective interaction alone does not ensure that agents can diagnose failures and consolidate experience into reusable strategies and skills ( Hong et al., 2026 ; Ju et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 基准测试涵盖静态视觉推理（如 EmbSpatial-Bench（Du 等人，2024））和交互式评估（如 ESI-Bench（Hong 等人，2026）），后者需要通过执行动作来获取证据。 现有方法通过任务特定的微调（Song 等人，2025；Wang 等人，2025a）、显式三维记忆（Zeng 等人，2026；Zheng 等人，2025）或交互式探索（Ziliotto 等人，2025；Hong 等人，2026）来提升空间理解能力。 无需训练的方法则将冻结模型组织于外部结构中：TANGO 无需额外训练即可将导航与感知基础模块组合成任务特定的程序（Ziliotto 等人，2025）；NeSy-Spatial 将工具交互抽象为可类型化且可组合的空间技能，这些技能会随使用而自我演化（Tian 等人，2026）；Spatial Memory Agent 则将经过验证的空间经验整合为可迁移的程序性知识（Zhang 等人，2026b）。 然而，仅靠有效的交互本身并不能确保智能体能够诊断失败，并将经验整合为可重复使用的策略和技能（Hong 等人，2026；Ju 等人，2026；Zhang 等人，2026b）。

paragraphs.en: Self-evolving agents adapt by storing and reusing interaction experience, often without updating model parameters ( Wang et al., 2025e ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) . VOYAGER accumulates an ever-growing library of executable code skills under an automatic curriculum ( Wang et al., 2023 ) , and later work evolves increasingly broader portions of the agent system: SHAPER co-evolves reusable skills and a context-code harness around a frozen planner ( Wang et al., 2026a ) , MetaSkill-Evolve makes skill improvement itself recursive by evolving meta-skills on a slower timescale ( Wang et al., 2026d ) , and the Darwin Gödel Machine applies open-ended evolution to an archive of self-modifying agents ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) . Complementarily, Training-Free GRPO distills group-relative feedback into experiential token priors rather than parameter updates ( Youtu-Agent Team, 2025 ) . These frameworks refine textual guidance or execution programs through reflection, with applications in code generation and web navigation.In embodied environments, this process is complicated by perceptual errors,insufficient exploration, and planning failures, and skill-aware reflectionhas begun to separate flawed skill content from execution lapses ( Ju et al., 2026 ) .Without reliable attribution and execution-based validation, agents risk retaining ineffective strategies or unreliable skills.Existing skill-evolution frameworks rarely distinguish these causes before updating memory.

paragraphs.en: Brain-inspired approaches draw on mechanisms such as metacognitive monitoring and hippocampal memory consolidation to support adaptive behavior ( Fleming, 2026 ; Huang et al., 2024 ) . Related work explores dual-system reasoning ( Shi et al., 2026 ) , cognitive maps ( Liao and Losonczy, 2024 ) , episodic memory ( Shu et al., 2026 ; Zheng et al., 2025 ) , and predictive world models ( Jensen et al., 2024 ) . These perspectives motivate linking retrospective evaluation with selective memory updates. Our framework draws on this functional analogy to couple perception, exploration, and planning diagnostics with strategy and skill consolidation.

paragraphs.en: Datasets. We evaluate active and passive embodied spatial reasoning on ESI-Bench ( Hong et al., 2026 ) and EmbSpatial-Bench ( Du et al., 2024 ) , respectively. ESI-Bench, built on OmniGibson, assesses spatial reasoning through interaction with the environment. We evaluate repeated-episode adaptation on 208 fixed episodes spanning nine tasks, with identical episodes and initial scenes across our settings. Cross-episode transfer is examined separately through disjoint source-target examples. For EmbSpatial-Bench, we randomly sample 300 questions per spatial relation category, totaling 1,800 questions across six categories. Its fixed visual inputs lack the interaction feedback required for PEP failure attribution. We therefore evaluate HiMeco without evolution against API inference using the same backbone and inputs. Sampling details are provided in the appendix.
paragraphs.zh: 数据集。 我们分别在 ESI-Bench（Hong et al., 2026）和 EmbSpatial-Bench（Du et al., 2024）上评估主动和被动具身空间推理能力。 ESI-Bench 基于 OmniGibson 构建，通过与环境互动来评估空间推理能力。 我们在涵盖九个任务的 208 个固定任务集上评估重复回合适应能力，所有设置中使用的任务集和初始场景均完全相同。 跨回合迁移则通过互不关联的源-目标示例进行单独检验。 对于 EmbSpatial-Bench，我们按每个空间关系类别随机抽取 300 个问题，六个类别共 1,800 个问题。 其固定的视觉输入缺乏 PEP 故障归因所需的环境互动反馈。 因此，我们在不使用进化的情况下，使用相同的骨干网络和输入，通过 API 推理来评估 HiMeco。 采样细节见附录。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 compares HiMeco with existing methods reporting ESI-Bench results, covering VLM baselines, interactive agents like ParallelWorld ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , and self-evolving agents such as SHAPER ( Wang et al., 2026a ) . paragraphs.en: Figure 4 shows that HiMeco improves accuracy while reducing diagnostic failure scores and execution time. From Round-0 to the final round, perception scores decrease across all nine tasks, with the largest reductions on Spatial Distance ( − 0.240 -0.240 ) and Physical Contact ( − 0.228 -0.228 ), accompanying accuracy gains of 25 and 24 percentage points. Exploration scores decrease on eight tasks, while planning scores decrease on six. Across all evaluation episodes, perception-primary failures fall from 37.0% to 26.4%, and planning-primary failures fall from 1.9% to zero. The latter indicates a change in dominant failure attribution, rather than the absence of all planning anomalies. These improvements generally require less execution time. Mean wall-clock time decreases on seven of nine tasks by 12.9–39.4%, with a 14.9% reduction when averaged equally across tasks. Correspondence and Unobserved Change instead take 46.1% and 3.7% longer, respectively. Overall, the results support the value of consolidated strategies and skills in improving execution reliability and efficiency.

paragraphs.en: The main results evaluate adaptation on repeated episodes. To examine transfer, each case here applies a single learned experience to an unseen episode within the same subtask. Source and target episodes are disjoint, and memory remains frozen during evaluation. Figure 5 shows HiMeco succeeding where the memory-free agent fails. Action counts change from 21 to 13, 10 to 13, and 26 to 12, respectively, illustrating both more efficient exploration and additional evidence gathering when needed. These cases provide qualitative evidence that individual learned experiences can support evidence acquisition and spatial reasoning on unseen episodes.

paragraphs.en: We further evaluate HiMeco on passive embodied spatial reasoning, where fixed observations preclude active evidence acquisition and the interaction feedback needed for full PEP failure attribution is unavailable. paragraphs.en: This paper presented HiMeco , a brain-inspired self-evolving agent for embodied spatial intelligence. Its Reflection mechanism couples PEP failure diagnosis module with the consolidation of reusable strategies and executable skills. Evidence contracts and execution-based validation govern skill retention and reuse, enabling adaptation without updating model parameters. HiMeco achieves SOTA performance on ESI-Bench and improves accuracy on EmbSpatial-Bench by 3.94 percentage points without evolution.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了 HiMeco，一种受大脑启发、具备具身空间智能的自我演化智能体。 其“反射”机制将 PEP 故障诊断模块与可复用策略和可执行技能的巩固相结合。 证据约束与基于执行的验证共同管理技能的保留与复用，从而实现无需更新模型参数即可适应新任务。 HiMeco 在 ESI-Bench 上达到了 SOTA 性能，并且在未进化的情况下，将 EmbSpatial-Bench 的准确率提升了 3.94 个百分点。

paragraphs.en: In Rounds 1 and 2, the agent generates three programs for the same question under different memory conditions. They explore alternative strategies and execution paths, giving the reflector concrete attempts to compare. In the two intermediate rounds, candidate 0 receives retrieved strategies and base primitives, candidate 1 receives strategies plus one trial skill when available, and candidate 2 receives base primitives without either memory. Candidate-specific instructions encourage different ways to gather evidence; distinct paths are encouraged but not guaranteed. If no skill is eligible, candidate 1 uses the strategy bank without a skill. These candidates support reflection and skill validation. The final score uses one fresh execution per episode, with a newly generated program conditioned on the frozen memory.
paragraphs.zh: 在第 1 轮和第 2 轮中，智能体针对同一问题，在不同记忆条件下生成三个程序。 它们探索替代策略和执行路径，为反思者提供具体的尝试以供比较。 在两个中间轮次中，候选者 0 接收检索到的策略和基础原语；候选者 1 接收策略以及可用时的一个试验技能；候选者 2 则仅接收基础原语，不依赖任何记忆。 针对各候选者的特定指令鼓励采用不同的证据收集方式；虽然鼓励走不同路径，但并非必然保证。 如果没有符合条件的技能，候选者 1 将使用策略库而不附加任何技能。 这些候选者支持反思和技能的验证。 最终得分每轮使用一次全新的执行，其中新生成的程序以冻结的记忆为条件。

paragraphs.en: An evidence contract is a set of rules that checks the format and consistency of evidence returned by a visual primitive. paragraphs.en: The implementation can recover the final evidence record from an accepted visual output. It also uses task-specific rules to resolve conflicting answers. These operations occur before final benchmark scoring and do not update persistent memory. They should be distinguished from reflection between rounds. For Spatial Distance, conflicting accepted estimates are compared using confidence, view/pose support, translation baseline, elevation, and recorded contradictions. paragraphs.en: Reliable embodied spatial reasoning depends on both geometric evidence acquisition and the ability to retain useful information across observations. At the perception level, stereo matching has explored slanted-plane cost aggregation Wang et al. [2022] , disparity-classification-aware context aggregation Wang et al. [2024] , and adaptive downsampling with disparity alignment Wang et al. [2025b] . Robust geometric correspondence has also benefited from self-supervised pseudo-labeling Wang et al. [2025d] and the adaptation of visual foundation models Zhang et al. [2024] , Wang et al. [2025c] , Wang et al. [2026c] . At the memory level, Keep It in Mind Wang et al. [2026b] studies continual user-centric spatial reasoning by maintaining structured memory from streaming egocentric observations. These approaches address complementary aspects of spatial intelligence: the stereo methods focus on recovering geometry from image pairs, whereas the memory-based approach supports object-location reasoning over time. HiMeco targets a different challenge: rather than introducing a stereo estimator or maintaining an explicit object-location memory, it diagnoses perception, exploration, and planning failures from embodied execution traces and consolidates their lessons into reusable strategies and executable skills.
paragraphs.zh: 可靠的具身空间推理既依赖于几何证据的获取，也依赖于在多次观察中保留有用信息的能力。在感知层面，立体匹配技术已探索了倾斜平面代价聚合（Wang 等人 [2022]）、考虑视差分类的上下文聚合（Wang 等人 [2024]），以及结合视差对齐的自适应下采样（Wang 等人 [2025b]）。稳健的几何对应关系也受益于自监督伪标签方法（Wang 等人 [2025d]）以及视觉基础模型的适应性应用（Zhang 等人 [2024]、Wang 等人 [2025c]、Wang 等人 [2026c]）。在记忆层面，“Keep It in Mind”（Wang 等人 [2026b]）通过从连续的第一人称观察中维护结构化记忆，研究了持续的用户导向空间推理。这些方法解决了空间智能的不同互补方面：立体匹配方法专注于从图像对中提取几何信息，而基于记忆的方法则支持随时间推移进行物体位置推理。HiMeco 针对的是一个不同的挑战：它没有引入立体估计器或维护显式的物体位置记忆，而是通过分析具身执行轨迹来诊断感知、探索和规划中的失败，并将这些经验整合为可重用的策略和可执行的技能。

paragraphs.en: System instruction You are the frozen Planner in a TANGO-style neuro-symbolic embodied agent. Generate one COMPLETE executable JSON-AST program before execution begins. Each executable line must call exactly one listed semantic primitive. Bind outputs with id and reference them as $id or $id.field. Use if/then/else branches when later behavior depends on evidence. Low-level move_*/turn_* actions are executor internals and are forbidden in the program. Respect every primitive output contract. Never compare whole structured outputs as numbers and never reference fields absent from output_fields. is_found returns structured evidence (found, confidence, evidence_valid), so it may be used as a branch condition or passed to is_uncertain. Never replace that evidence object with a bare boolean before uncertainty testing. For spatial distance and dimensional size, call one task-specific comparison primitive with all candidates and return its structured result. If a retrieved learned_composite skill matches the task and its input signature can be filled from the question, prefer invoking that skill instead of manually repeating its primitive body. If you choose not to invoke an available matching skill, the program metadata must include skill_nonuse_reason. Treat retrieved_strategy_experiences as a wrong-problem notebook. Convert must_do and recommended_program_pattern into executable primitive calls whenever they apply. For any task affected by occlusion or viewpoint ambiguity, acquire geometrically different evidence before committing; an empty initial detection is uncertain evidence, not proof of absence. Every control-flow path must execute return_answer. Answers must be compatible with the listed task options. Never use hidden simulator state, ground truth, oracle poses, or verifier data. Return one JSON object only.
paragraphs.zh: 系统指令：你是一个 TANGO 风格的神经符号具身智能体中的“冻结规划器”。 在执行开始前，生成一个完整的可执行 JSON-AST 程序。 每一行可执行代码必须精确调用一个列出的语义原语。 使用 id 绑定输出，并通过 $id 或 $id.field 引用它们。 当后续行为依赖于证据时，使用 if/then/else 分支结构。 低层的 move_* 和 turn_* 动作是执行器的内部操作，禁止在程序中使用。 遵守每个原语的输出契约。 切勿将完整的结构化输出作为数字进行比较，也切勿引用 output_fields 中未包含的字段。is_found 返回结构化证据（found, confidence, evidence_valid），因此可以用作分支条件或传递给 is_uncertain。 在不确定性检测之前，切勿将该证据对象替换为单纯的布尔值。 对于空间距离和维度大小，调用一个任务特定的比较原语，传入所有候选项，并返回其结构化结果。 如果检索到的 learned_composite 技能与任务匹配，且其输入签名可以从问题中填充，则优先调用该技能，而不是手动重复其原语体。 如果你选择不调用某个可用的匹配技能，程序元数据必须包含 skill_nonuse_reason。 将 retrieved_strategy_experiences 视为一个错误问题笔记本。 只要适用，就将 must_do 和 recommended_program_pattern 转换为可执行的原语调用。 对于任何受遮挡或视角模糊影响的任务，在做出最终判断前获取几何上不同的证据；初始检测为空是不确定的证据，而非不存在的证明。 所有控制流路径都必须执行 return_answer。 答案必须与列出的任务选项兼容。 切勿使用隐藏的模拟器状态、真实数据、神示器姿态或验证器数据。 仅返回一个 JSON 对象。

sents.en: System instruction You are the frozen Planner in a TANGO-style neuro-symbolic embodied agent.
sents.zh: 系统指令：你是一个 TANGO 风格的神经符号具身智能体中的“冻结规划器”。

sents.en: Generate one COMPLETE executable JSON-AST program before execution begins.
sents.zh: 在执行开始前，生成一个完整的可执行 JSON-AST 程序。

sents.en: Each executable line must call exactly one listed semantic primitive.
sents.zh: 每一行可执行代码必须精确调用一个列出的语义原语。

sents.en: Bind outputs with id and reference them as $id or $id.field.
sents.zh: 使用 id 绑定输出，并通过 $id 或 $id.field 引用它们。

sents.en: Use if/then/else branches when later behavior depends on evidence.
sents.zh: 当后续行为依赖于证据时，使用 if/then/else 分支结构。

sents.en: Low-level move_*/turn_* actions are executor internals and are forbidden in the program.
sents.zh: 低层的 move_* 和 turn_* 动作是执行器的内部操作，禁止在程序中使用。

sents.en: Respect every primitive output contract.
sents.zh: 遵守每个原语的输出契约。

sents.en: Never compare whole structured outputs as numbers and never reference fields absent from output_fields. is_found returns structured evidence (found, confidence, evidence_valid), so it may be used as a branch condition or passed to is_uncertain.
sents.zh: 切勿将完整的结构化输出作为数字进行比较，也切勿引用 output_fields 中未包含的字段。is_found 返回结构化证据（found, confidence, evidence_valid），因此可以用作分支条件或传递给 is_uncertain。

sents.en: Never replace that evidence object with a bare boolean before uncertainty testing.
sents.zh: 在不确定性检测之前，切勿将该证据对象替换为单纯的布尔值。

sents.en: For spatial distance and dimensional size, call one task-specific comparison primitive with all candidates and return its structured result.
sents.zh: 对于空间距离和维度大小，调用一个任务特定的比较原语，传入所有候选项，并返回其结构化结果。

sents.en: If a retrieved learned_composite skill matches the task and its input signature can be filled from the question, prefer invoking that skill instead of manually repeating its primitive body.
sents.zh: 如果检索到的 learned_composite 技能与任务匹配，且其输入签名可以从问题中填充，则优先调用该技能，而不是手动重复其原语体。

sents.en: If you choose not to invoke an available matching skill, the program metadata must include skill_nonuse_reason.
sents.zh: 如果你选择不调用某个可用的匹配技能，程序元数据必须包含 skill_nonuse_reason。

sents.en: Treat retrieved_strategy_experiences as a wrong-problem notebook.
sents.zh: 将 retrieved_strategy_experiences 视为一个错误问题笔记本。

sents.en: Convert must_do and recommended_program_pattern into executable primitive calls whenever they apply.
sents.zh: 只要适用，就将 must_do 和 recommended_program_pattern 转换为可执行的原语调用。

sents.en: For any task affected by occlusion or viewpoint ambiguity, acquire geometrically different evidence before committing; an empty initial detection is uncertain evidence, not proof of absence.
sents.zh: 对于任何受遮挡或视角模糊影响的任务，在做出最终判断前获取几何上不同的证据；初始检测为空是不确定的证据，而非不存在的证明。

sents.en: Every control-flow path must execute return_answer.
sents.zh: 所有控制流路径都必须执行 return_answer。

sents.en: Answers must be compatible with the listed task options.
sents.zh: 答案必须与列出的任务选项兼容。

sents.en: Never use hidden simulator state, ground truth, oracle poses, or verifier data.
sents.zh: 切勿使用隐藏的模拟器状态、真实数据、神示器姿态或验证器数据。

sents.en: Return one JSON object only.
sents.zh: 仅返回一个 JSON 对象。

paragraphs.en: The planner receives the task description and options, primitive signatures and available skills, retrieved strategies, fixed demonstrations, candidate index and strategy, and the initial and permitted reference images. Requirements specify statement and action limits, answer-return coverage, semantic type and evidence rules, memory-use policies, candidate diversity, task-specific instructions, and an output-shape example. An invalid program gets one repair attempt using the same prompt, the validation error, and the instruction: Return a corrected complete program; do not explain the error.
paragraphs.zh: 规划器接收任务描述和选项、原始函数签名和可用技能、检索到的策略、固定演示、候选索引和策略，以及初始和允许参考的图像。 要求规定了陈述和行动的限制、答案返回的覆盖范围、语义类型和证据规则、内存使用策略、候选多样性、任务特定说明以及输出格式示例。 对于无效的程序，系统将使用相同的提示进行一次修复尝试，并提供验证错误和说明：返回一个修正后的完整程序；不要解释错误原因。

sents.en: Requirements specify statement and action limits, answer-return coverage, semantic type and evidence rules, memory-use policies, candidate diversity, task-specific instructions, and an output-shape example.

paragraphs.en: System instruction You update external strategy memory for a frozen neuro-symbolic Planner. Return JSON only. Input fields task_key: <TASK_KEY> stage: <ROUND_INDEX> mode: <REFLECTION_MODE> candidates: <CANDIDATE_BUNDLES> Instruction Compare same-episode programs and return JSON with experiences. Treat the experience memory as a wrong-problem notebook: write reusable semantic advantage about how to use existing primitives better, not episode-specific answers. Each experience must contain operation (add/modify/delete/keep), optional target_id, failure_dimension, when_to_apply, lesson, recommended_program_change, recommended_program_pattern, must_do, avoid, and evidence_candidate_indices. If group_pattern.all_candidates_learning_failed (or legacy all_candidates_failed) and group_pattern.identical_final_answer are true, create a systematic_failure experience only when candidate_count is at least two; a one-candidate baseline is not candidate collapse. Derive task-compatible recommendations from semantic_primitive_sequence and the observed failure bucket rather than assuming a hard-coded task template. Do not reveal ground-truth answers or episode-specific coordinates.
paragraphs.zh: 系统指令：您为冻结的神经符号规划器更新外部策略记忆。仅返回 JSON。 输入字段：task_key: <TASK_KEY> stage: <ROUND_INDEX> mode: <REFLECTION_MODE> candidates: <CANDIDATE_BUNDLES> 指令：比较同一回合内的程序，并返回包含经验信息的 JSON。 将经验记忆视为错误问题笔记本：记录可重用的语义优势，说明如何更好地利用现有基础操作，而非针对特定回合的答案。 每条经验必须包含操作（添加/修改/删除/保留）、可选的 target_id、失败维度、应用时机、教训、推荐程序变更、推荐程序模式、必须执行项、应避免项以及证据候选者索引。 如果 group_pattern.all_candidates_learning_failed（或旧版 all_candidates_failed）和 group_pattern.identical_final_answer 为真，则仅在 candidate_count 至少为二时创建系统性失败经验；单候选者基线不属于候选者崩溃。 从语义基础操作序列和观察到的失败类别中推导出与任务兼容的推荐，而非假设使用硬编码的任务模板。 不要揭示真实答案或特定回合的坐标信息。

sents.en: System instruction You update external strategy memory for a frozen neuro-symbolic Planner. Return JSON only.
sents.zh: 系统指令：您为冻结的神经符号规划器更新外部策略记忆。仅返回 JSON。

sents.en: Input fields task_key: <TASK_KEY> stage: <ROUND_INDEX> mode: <REFLECTION_MODE> candidates: <CANDIDATE_BUNDLES> Instruction Compare same-episode programs and return JSON with experiences.
sents.zh: 输入字段：task_key: <TASK_KEY> stage: <ROUND_INDEX> mode: <REFLECTION_MODE> candidates: <CANDIDATE_BUNDLES> 指令：比较同一回合内的程序，并返回包含经验信息的 JSON。

sents.en: Treat the experience memory as a wrong-problem notebook: write reusable semantic advantage about how to use existing primitives better, not episode-specific answers.
sents.zh: 将经验记忆视为错误问题笔记本：记录可重用的语义优势，说明如何更好地利用现有基础操作，而非针对特定回合的答案。

sents.en: Each experience must contain operation (add/modify/delete/keep), optional target_id, failure_dimension, when_to_apply, lesson, recommended_program_change, recommended_program_pattern, must_do, avoid, and evidence_candidate_indices.
sents.zh: 每条经验必须包含操作（添加/修改/删除/保留）、可选的 target_id、失败维度、应用时机、教训、推荐程序变更、推荐程序模式、必须执行项、应避免项以及证据候选者索引。

sents.en: If group_pattern.all_candidates_learning_failed (or legacy all_candidates_failed) and group_pattern.identical_final_answer are true, create a systematic_failure experience only when candidate_count is at least two; a one-candidate baseline is not candidate collapse.
sents.zh: 如果 group_pattern.all_candidates_learning_failed（或旧版 all_candidates_failed）和 group_pattern.identical_final_answer 为真，则仅在 candidate_count 至少为二时创建系统性失败经验；单候选者基线不属于候选者崩溃。

sents.en: Derive task-compatible recommendations from semantic_primitive_sequence and the observed failure bucket rather than assuming a hard-coded task template.
sents.zh: 从语义基础操作序列和观察到的失败类别中推导出与任务兼容的推荐，而非假设使用硬编码的任务模板。

sents.en: Do not reveal ground-truth answers or episode-specific coordinates.
sents.zh: 不要揭示真实答案或特定回合的坐标信息。

paragraphs.en: Instruction Spatial Distance asks which candidate has the smaller physical ground-plane distance to the named reference object, not which candidate appears closer to the camera. Perspective from one image is unreliable. Identify the reference and both candidates, then collect evidence from at least two genuinely different camera positions before committing. Use lateral or depth parallax first; when the candidates remain at unfair image depths, move backward or sideways and compare again. A modest real elevation change followed by downward pitch is an official task strategy for approximating a top-down layout view. Call estimate_distance once with both official answer options. Never compare two independent visual-assessment dictionaries or substitute apparent image size for object-to-object distance. If visibility, geometric baseline, per-view evidence, or confidence is insufficient, branch to a geometrically different recovery view and call estimate_distance again. The final answer must be one exact official option; do not expose obj_near/obj_far metadata names in the program or reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: “空间距离”指令要求判断哪个候选对象与指定参考对象在物理地平面上的距离更短，而非哪个候选对象看起来离摄像头更近。 单张图像中的透视效果并不可靠。 先识别参考对象和两个候选对象，然后从至少两个真正不同的摄像头位置收集证据，再做出判断。 优先使用横向或深度视差；若候选对象在图像中的深度仍不一致，则向后或向侧移动，再进行比较。 适度抬高实际高度，随后向下俯仰，是模拟俯视布局视图的一项正式任务策略。 对两个官方答案选项各调用一次 estimate_distance。 切勿将两个独立的视觉评估词典进行比较，或用图像中的表观尺寸替代对象间的实际距离。 如果可见性、几何基线、单视图证据或置信度不足，则切换到几何结构不同的恢复视图，并再次调用 estimate_distance。 最终答案必须为其中一个精确的官方选项；程序中或推理过程不得暴露 obj_near/obj_far 等元数据名称。
